properties.bedrock_formation: Honaker Dolomite and Rome Formation complex
properties.lithology: Interbedded massive gray dolomite, microcrystalline limestone, and calcareous shale
properties.topsoil: Dunmore-Carbo silt loam complex (deep, well-drained, clayey subsoil residuum)
properties.drainage: Appalachian Ridge and Valley dendritic drainage, draining toward Brush Creek basin

facade_materials: wire-cut red-brown Appalachian clay brick veneer
horizontal white aluminum/vinyl siding on upper tier
structures.fenestration: Double-hung vinyl-clad windows, fixed picture window framing rear yard
structures.foundation: Poured concrete and concrete masonry unit partially exposed basement level

civil_infrastructure.access_road: Hiwassee Hill Drive Extended SE (worn asphalt surface with aggregate exposed edges)
civil_infrastructure.driveway: Poured concrete apron leading to lower-level basement garage bay
civil_infrastructure.utilities: Overhead electrical drop with wooden utility pole, pole-mounted transformer

properties.vegetation_health: Dense mature deciduous canopy characteristic of Southern Appalachian Ridge and Valley foothills

properties.atmosphere: Warm golden raking sunlight skimming across the hillside, casting long sweeping shadows eastward, light mist settling in valley depressions, deep amber highlights on brick and tree foliage
